en.title: David Corenswet Sheds Superman Suit for Grit in 'Mr. Irrelevant'
en.summary: Before donning the iconic cape, David Corenswet tackled a challenging NFL drama, 'Mr. Irrelevant,' earning praise from industry insiders. The film, drawing comparisons to 'The Blind Side,' tells the inspiring true story of John Tuggle, the ultimate underdog.
en.body:
While many fans eagerly await **David Corenswet**'s debut as Superman, the actor has already delivered a performance that has Hollywood buzzing. His turn in the biographical sports drama **'Mr. Irrelevant'** has generated significant Oscar buzz, with screenings for NFL legends reportedly leaving a strong impression.

## The Ultimate Underdog Story

**'Mr. Irrelevant'** chronicles the true story of **John Tuggle**, a running back who became the last player selected in the 1983 NFL Draft. Carrying the unfortunate moniker of "Mr. Irrelevant," Tuggle defied all odds to not only make the roster of the New York Giants but to carve out a place for himself. The film, slated for a December 25, 2026 release, is already being hailed as a potential awards contender, drawing parallels to the heartwarming, success-against-all-odds narrative of **'The Blind Side.'** Corenswet’s commitment to the role was evident, as he developed shin splints during intense training and worked closely with a middle-school football coach to master the sport's fundamentals. The film also features strong supporting performances from **Isabel May** and **Michael Shannon**.

## Beyond the Cape: A Star-Making Turn

For **Corenswet**, this role represents a significant opportunity to showcase his dramatic depth. Having recently been cast as the Man of Steel, the perception might be that his career is solely defined by superheroics. However, **'Mr. Irrelevant'** demonstrates his capacity for raw, grounded performances. The film’s narrative arc, focusing on perseverance and the triumph of an overlooked talent, is ripe for critical acclaim and audience connection. The fact that the film has been screened for NFL veterans suggests a level of authenticity and respect for the sport that could resonate deeply with a wide audience, particularly those who appreciate sports dramas with a powerful human element.

## What's Next

With a release date set for Christmas Day 2026, **'Mr. Irrelevant'** is poised to be a major contender during the next awards season. Audiences can anticipate a moving story of determination, and Corenswet fans will have a chance to see him in a completely different light before he flies into theaters as Superman.
